prompts.male: Create a production 2D game sprite atlas from the attached MALE dwarf turnaround reference. Reference is identity/proportions guidance, NOT a target for 3D rendering. Hand-painted 2D fantasy game illustration with clean dark contour lines, restrained cel/painterly shading, readable small silhouettes. Preserve his recognizable large reddish nose, broad brows, grey-brown wavy hair, full grey beard, broad thick shoulders, large hands and feet, short sturdy legs. Adult male, bare chest, cream opaque boxer underwear only. No equipment. Exactly THREE separate full-body figures in ONE horizontal row: FRONT facing viewer, RIGHT SIDE facing right, BACK facing away. Neutral standing arms slightly away from sides, feet grounded. Orthographic eye-level. All figures EXACTLY same head-top and foot-baseline, same scale; ample transparent space between them. Canvas preferably 1536x1024, three equal 512px cells. Each figure centered x=256,768,1280, top y=100, feet y=920. Front/back maximum width 390, side max width 300. True transparent background, no shadows on ground, no labels, no panels, no text, no grids. Flat sprite artwork, not photoreal, not clay, not a 3D model render. This is the main asset for a colony simulation, precise sheet alignment essential.
prompts.female: Production 2D hand-painted sprite atlas. Input 1 is the female dwarf identity and body-proportion reference. Input 2 is the male sprite style reference ONLY. Draw the FEMALE dwarf from input1 in exactly matching ink contour and softly painted style to input2, NOT a 3D render. Preserve her older adult strong face, large reddish nose, grey-brown wavy hair, thick shoulders, stout belly and very short powerful legs. NO BEARD. Cream opaque tank-top undershirt and cream boxer shorts, bare feet, no other equipment. THREE separated full-body orthographic views in a horizontal row, in this precise order: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE facing right, BACK. Neutral resting pose arms slightly away from torso. Same scale, same head height, same baseline, clear transparent gaps. Wide canvas with plenty of margin, don't let hands touch neighbouring figures. Absolutely transparent background with alpha, no colored backdrop, no ground, no shadows, no text. Full body all feet and hair included. It must look like drawn 2D game artwork, not photorealistic.
prompts.clothing: Create a TRANSPARENT modular clothing sprite atlas for the attached 2D dwarf sprites. Match the hand-drawn dark ink outline, softly painted shading and stocky anatomy EXACTLY. This is an equipment-only sheet: NO PERSON, NO HEAD, NO SKIN, NO HAIR, NO HANDS, NO BARE FEET, NO BODY visible anywhere. Invisible mannequin / ghost garment presentation. Exactly THREE upright outfit arrangements horizontally: FRONT at left, RIGHT SIDE facing right in middle, BACK at right, matching the poses and proportions of the reference sprites. Each arrangement contains these separated wearable pieces in anatomically correct positions: simple muted teal sleeveless work VEST at torso, brown leather BELTED KNEE-LENGTH TROUSERS under the vest, dark brown LEATHER BOOTS at feet. The arm spaces are completely transparent. Leave a SMALL TRANSPARENT GAP between vest hem and trouser waistband, and between trouser cuffs and boots, so each garment can be individually extracted. Vest must follow stout belly contour, front has a low U-shaped neckline to leave beard visible; side vest is visible mainly to the right of invisible upper arm, with arm-shaped transparent cutout. No sleeves, capes, shoulder pads or weapons. Scale and placement correspond to attached reference: tops of heads would be y=70, feet y=945; vest occupies approximately y=300-555, trousers y=575-745, boots y=775-945 on 1536x1024 canvas. Keep the three arrangements distinctly separated by generous empty alpha space. Neutral light. Clean alpha background, no gradient, no ground, no panels, no text, no grid. This is reusable in-game 2D overlay art, NOT a 3D render.
